defs.def: in a voice that other people can hear 出声地

ex.s: Spend a few minutes reading the material aloud.
ex.t: 花几分钟大声朗读材料。

ex.s: That’s what happened the day my club was reading aloud a poem by Henry Longfellow.
Miss Chevalier pretended not to have noticed my red face and handed me a dictionary, asking me to read its definition aloud.
ex.t: 传粉昆虫：离开还是留下B.

ex.s: Everyone was silent, wait to see who would be called upon to read his and her paragraph aloud.
ex.t: 大家都安静地______等待（wait）看谁会被叫起来大声朗读自己的段落。

defs.def: in a loud voice 大声地

ex.s: His poetry generally has a regular rhythm and rhyme, and is easy to read aloud and remember.
ex.t: 他的诗歌通常有规律的节奏和韵律，易于大声朗读和记忆。

ex.s: Using Structures 1 Read the conversation aloud and pay attention to the tones of the tag questions.
ex.t: 使用结构1大声朗读对话，并注意标签问题的语气。

ex.s: Read the words aloud to each other, and put them into the correct groups.
ex.t: 将单词大声朗读给对方听，并将其分成正确的小组。

ex.s: She doesn’t have much time to read, so she enjoys hearing me read aloud to her.
ex.t: 她没有太多时间阅读，所以她喜欢听我大声朗读。

ex.s: All controls will respond to voice commands, so if you want to change your routine, you just say aloud what you want and the home system will obey.
ex.t: 所有控件都将响应语音命令，因此，如果您想更改例行程序，只需大声说出您想要的内容，家庭系统就会服从。
